name: ckz_eff2500_fidelity_ab
_design: Confirm the two cheap floor-fixes the aggregate implicated for the library's 68% floor: LoRA strength 0.85->1.0 (1.0 minimizes floor globally; library's 0.85 was single-loop overfit) and steps 50->100 (aggregate hints 100>50, theory: more final steps = more HF detail = less muffle). 2 dense Cmin init loops x strength[0.85,1.0] x steps[50,100] x 2 seeds, noise 0.6, FULL-LoRA init regime. If strength1.0/steps100 cuts the floor + de-muffles, regenerate the library at the winner. Rate timbre(brightness!)+melody+note 'muffled?'.
